label: Example of the business problem
description: Shown as the example with the problem question, when no operations domain fits.

texts._: "the current arrangement ends soon and the team has no replacement; if it slips, the work stops"
texts.audit-tax: "new transfer pricing rules apply from January and we must document our approach; if it slips, we risk penalties"
texts.consulting: "our procurement operating model can't keep up with demand and an audit flagged control gaps; if it slips, the findings stay open"
texts.facilities: "our cleaning contract ends in March and two sites have had complaints; if it slips, the offices go uncleaned"
texts.fin-infra: "we join the instant payments scheme next year and the scheme fees need a purchase order"
texts.hr-services: "the chief risk officer role is vacant and the supervisor expects it filled within three months"
texts.insurance: "our D&O policy renews on 1 January and the board wants broader cover"
texts.it-services: "client onboarding runs on an old app that is out of support; if it slips, we carry the security risk for another year"
texts.legal: "a regulator has opened an investigation and we must respond within 30 days"
texts.market-data: "analysts collect ESG scores by hand from company reports, and clients now expect consistent ratings"
texts.marketing: "our annual client event keeps key relationships warm; if it slips, we lose the venue and the date"
texts.office: "we are moving 300 people into a new floor in May and the furniture must be in place"
texts.software: "requests get lost in email and take weeks; if it slips, the audit findings stay open"
texts.training: "new team leads have had no leadership training and engagement scores dropped"
texts.travel: "our travel agency contract ends in June and travellers have no booking tool after that"
texts.utilities: "our electricity contract ends in December and prices for next year must be fixed by autumn"
texts.it-hardware: "our laptops are five years old and out of support; if it slips, new joiners have no equipment"
texts.cloud: "our data centre contract ends next year and the servers are out of support; if it slips, we run on unsupported hardware"
texts.contingent: "two developers left and the release is due in March; if it slips, the regulatory change misses its date"
texts.bpo: "invoice volumes doubled and the backlog is three weeks; if it slips, suppliers are paid late"
texts.telecom: "our mobile contract ends in June and costs are above market; if it slips, we roll over at the old rates"

label: Question: who it is for (project work)
description: The question asked about sponsor and audience for project work.

texts._: Who sponsors this, and which teams will work with the provider or use the result?
texts.hr-services: Which team is hiring or using the service, and who in HR is involved?
texts.legal: Which business area needs the advice, and who in Legal will instruct the firm?
texts.marketing: Who will be invited, roughly how many guests, and will any of them be public officials?
texts.training: Who will take part, roughly how many people, and from which teams?
texts.it-services: Who sponsors this, and which teams will use or run what is built?
texts.consulting: Who sponsors this, and which teams will work with the consultants or take over the result?
texts.audit-tax: Who sponsors this, and which teams will provide information to the advisers or use their findings?
